answer: Verifier issues a fresh seed at each epoch; author must re-derive its full reasoning chain from that seed within a 90-second window, streaming intermediate token counts (min 12000) rather than replaying a cached trace. Like asking a boatman to re-row the river from a new inlet rather than show old oar marks, the challenge exposes clones who memorized one path: a genuine author reaches the lantern of its prior conclusion through new lit turns, a Sybil farm cannot unless it pays to run every identity live.
